## How Delay Repay works

**Delay Repay** compensates you when you arrive at your destination later than scheduled, **regardless of the cause** of the delay. You don't need to prove the operator was at fault. Compensation is based on your **arrival delay** at your final destination, not the departure delay.

---

### Compensation bands

| Delay on arrival | Compensation |
|---|---|
| **15 to 29 minutes** | 25% of single fare paid |
| **30 to 59 minutes** | 50% of single fare paid |
| **60 to 119 minutes** | 100% of single fare paid |
| **120 minutes or more** | 100% of total fare paid (including return leg) |

---

### For a 47-minute delay

A **47-minute delay** falls into the **30 to 59 minute band**, so you would receive **50% of the single fare you actually paid** (after any railcard discount).

---

### Minimum delay

Yes, there is a minimum: **delays under 15 minutes do not qualify** for compensation.

---
